user.title: Connect to WAHA
user.description: Enter your self-hosted WAHA server's address and API key.

session.title: Create the WAHA session?
session.description: The session "{session}" does not exist on this WAHA server yet. Home Assistant can create it now.

callback_url.title: Set the webhook callback URL
callback_url.description: Home Assistant could not determine a URL WAHA can use to reach it. Enter the base URL WAHA should use (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8123).

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate WAHA
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for this WAHA connection is no longer valid. Enter a new one.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure WAHA connection
reconfigure.description: Session "{session}" cannot be changed here -- add a new connection instead.

error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected by WAHA.
error.insufficient_permissions: This API key does not have permission for that action.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the WAHA server.

abort.already_configured: A connection to this WAHA session already exists.

data.fire_message_sent_events: Fire an event for messages sent from WhatsApp itself

data.notify_target: Notify target (a chat or group id)
data.auto_restart_enabled: Automatically restart a failed or stopped session

data_description.send_queue_preset: "off" (default) skips the human-like typing delay and pacing gap; the typing pipeline itself still runs.
data_description.auto_restart_enabled: Off by default -- a dashboard-initiated stop looks the same as a fault, so this can restart a session you meant to leave stopped.

register_webhook.name: Register webhook
register_webhook.description: Force-registers (or repairs) this integration's webhook on the WAHA session, even if it is currently WORKING.

unregister_webhook.name: Unregister webhook
unregister_webhook.description: Removes this integration's webhook from the WAHA session.

phone_number.title: Enter your phone number
phone_number.description: Enter the WhatsApp number to link, in international format.

show_code.title: Enter this code in WhatsApp
show_code.description: On your phone: WhatsApp > Linked Devices > Link with phone number > enter the code: {code}

webhook_drift.title: Webhook needs to be re-registered
webhook_drift.description: The WAHA session is WORKING, so re-registering the webhook requires a brief restart of the session. Continue?

confirm.title: Re-register the webhook?
confirm.description: This restarts the WhatsApp session for a few seconds.

webhook_drift_unfixable.title: Webhook registration could not be repaired automatically
webhook_drift_unfixable.description: Home Assistant could not safely bring the WAHA session's webhook configuration back in line. Check the WAHA dashboard directly.

hmac_mismatch.title: Webhook signature key may be out of date
hmac_mismatch.description: Home Assistant has rejected many webhook deliveries with an invalid signature. This can regenerate the key and re-register it.

confirm.title: Rotate the webhook signature key?
confirm.description: This restarts the WhatsApp session for a few seconds if it is currently WORKING.

webhook_unreachable.title: No webhook deliveries received
webhook_unreachable.description: The WhatsApp session has been WORKING for a while, but Home Assistant has not received any webhook deliveries from it -- including its own connectivity self-check. Check that WAHA can reach Home Assistant's address, and consider setting a callback URL override in this integration's options.

passkey_required.title: WhatsApp passkey confirmation needed
passkey_required.description: WAHA is waiting for passkey linking, which this integration doesn't support directly. Open the WAHA dashboard to continue: {dashboard_url}

send_rate_limited.title: WhatsApp is rate-limiting sends
send_rate_limited.description: WAHA returned a rate-limit response for a send. The affected chat (or the whole session) is cooling down automatically; nothing is restarted or re-paired.
